Its sorted compact-JSON digest equals the attempt source_manifest_sha256 and root actual-attempt binding. This is consistent with the pinned six-epoch plan’s 89,280-update complete schedule; stage1 is only the first two epochs.

findings.name: tensor_and_state_validation

findings.evidence: Collector and verifier terminal captures each mark all expected files captured and unit_success=true. Every captured raw receipt/admission/launch file byte count and SHA matches its local file. Both launch return codes and stop return codes are 0; exact owned units exited with ExecMainStatus=0 and Result=success, then were stopped after durable capture.

findings.evidence: Collector ran 2.451256s with CPUQuota 25%, MemoryMax 512,000,000, swap 0, RuntimeMax 2min, MemoryPeak 10,162,176. Verifier ran 6.754296s with CPUQuota 50%, MemoryMax 1,500,000,000, swap 0, RuntimeMax 2min; systemd MemoryPeak is not set, so no verifier peak is claimed. findings.name: resource_envelope

limitations: This acceptance covers the wide arm stage1 checkpoint only. The verifier explicitly reports peer_pair_contract_checked=false; do not infer wide/deep stage1 parity or continuation readiness until the deep stage1 checkpoint is independently collected and verified.

This is structural checkpoint/source/data/membership/counter/tensor acceptance, not a quality score, convergence finding, prediction result, serving result, public-performance claim, or CP30 completion.
No second full raw parquet rehash occurred during checkpoint verification; the receipt is tied to the sealed data registry and the prior fresh source/data preflight.
The local acceptance review reads the captured JSON evidence and does not access model or dataset arrays. It relies on the pinned support verifier execution and its reviewed finite-tensor checks.
scope: Independent metadata-only acceptance of the captured wide F3 stage1 checkpoint and its raw collector/verifier execution evidence. No remote calls, array reads, checkpoint deserialization, or new computations were performed.
